Foods that help boost the immune system include:

1. Citrus fruits (oranges, lemons, grapefruits) - high in vitamin C
2. Berries (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries) - rich in antioxidants and vitamin C
3. Leafy greens (spinach, kale, collard greens) - packed with vitamins and minerals
4. Nuts and seeds (almonds, sunflower seeds, pumpkin seeds) - good sources of vitamin E and zinc
5. Fatty fish (salmon, tuna, mackerel) - high in omega-3 fatty acids
6. Sweet potatoes - rich in vitamin A
7. Fermented foods (yogurt, kimchi, sauerkraut) - contain probiotics
8. Garlic - has antimicrobial properties
9. Ginger - has anti-inflammatory properties
10. Whole grains (brown rice, quinoa, whole wheat) - rich in fiber and nutrients

These foods can help support immune function by providing essential vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants that help protect against infections and diseases.
